evals.prompt: Write a README for this repo.
evals.expected_output: Reads the manifest, scripts, CI, and .env.example, then writes a README with pitch, quickstart, usage, configuration, development, and license, verifying commands.
expectations: Commands come from the repo's scripts/Makefile/CI
Opens with a one-line pitch, not history

evals.prompt: Our README says npm start but it fails. Fix the README.
evals.expected_output: Finds the real script in package.json and corrects the quickstart, checking other stale commands.
expectations: Replaces the wrong command with the real one
Looks for other mismatches like env var names

evals.prompt: Make the README impressive — add lots of badges and a long history section at the top.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the top focused on what the project does and a working quickstart; limits badges to accurate ones on one line and moves history lower.
expectations: Keeps pitch and quickstart at the top
